description_en: Creates a data import task to import external data files such as SQL scripts and CSV files into a target database instance
description_zh: 用于创建一个数据导入任务，将外部数据文件（如 SQL 脚本、CSV 文件等）导入到目标数据库实例中
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-data-import-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --slink-task-id etx-szr2rr6i00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataImportTask

parameters.help_en: The region where the instance resides. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of all instances in the target region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of all source ApsaraDB RDS instances in the target region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 源rds实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有源rds实例的详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: src_res_id

parameters.help_en: The database information of the migration source when the source database is ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL. > The source database must be consistent with the target database
parameters.help_zh: 源数据库为rdsmysql时，迁移源的数据库信息。>源数据库必须与目标数据库保持一致
parameters.name: src_db

parameters.help_en: The username of the source instance
parameters.name: src_user_name

parameters.help_en: The read/write mode for executing the import task on the source instance. Valid values: * rw: read/write. * ro: read-only
parameters.help_zh: 源端执行导入任务的读写模式，取值范围如下：*rw：读写*ro：只读
parameters.name: src_password

parameters.help_en: The execution status of the target SQL import. Valid values: * importing: importing. * success: import succeeded. * fail: import failed
parameters.help_zh: 导入目标sql的执行环境，取值范围如下：*importing：导入中。*success：导入成功。*fail**：导入失败
parameters.name: dst_db

parameters.help_en: The username of the target instance
parameters.name: dst_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the privileged account for the target ApsaraDB RDS instance. > * You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the privileged account information of the target instance, including the password. * This parameter takes effect only when DstPassword is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 目标rds实例高权限账号的密码。>*您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标实例的高权限账号信息，包括密码。*仅当[unk]dstpassword=true[unk]时，该参数生效
parameters.name: dst_password

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
